verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents signing in with personal accounts instead of managing API keys: 'Log in with GitHub' to use a Copilot account and 'Log in with OpenAI' to use a ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription. The free-tier part is thin. The only evidence is a community remark that OpenCode Zen 'almost always has a FREE coding model', and nothing shows that free access comes through a personal sign-in rather than an API key. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a free tier reachable via account login, details of free-tier limits, and independent hands-on confirmation of the login flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys

citations.quote: Log in with GitHub to use your Copilot account
Log in with OpenAI to use your ChatGPT Plus or Pro account
OpenCode Zen almost always has a FREE coding model.
